unit.why: A brief anecdote, quoted from an earlier book, about an unnamed gaon who posed a dream question about when the Messiah will come and got an answer in a dream. It sits inside a homiletic discussion of messianic timing.
unit.boundary_note: part of a running anthology of messianic-calculation excerpts; previous and next divisions are similar quotations

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי שגאון אחד עשה שאלת חלום
stories.end_quote: שמשיח יבוא קודם סיום אלף הששי
stories.summary_en: A gaon asks in a dream when the Messiah will come and is answered with the verse 'אמר אויב ארדוף אשיג אחלק שלל', whose five alef-initial words allude to five thousand years; this is taken as proof that the Messiah will come before the end of the sixth millennium.
